announcements.headline: Nelly Group appoints Lars Gezelius as new CEO
announcements.insight: Lars Gezelius replaces Josefin Dalum as CFO. This leadership change coincides with an ongoing share repurchase programme initiated in July.

announcements.headline: Josefin Dalum resigns as CFO of Nelly Group
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a change in senior financial leadership, which may introduce uncertainty regarding the continuity of financial reporting and strategic execution until a successor is appointed.

announcements.headline: Repurchases of ordinary shares in Nelly Group during week 38, 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a routine update on share repurchases, which generally signifies management's view on valuation and provides a mechanism for returning capital to shareholders. The specific financial impact or strategic intent cannot be determined from the headline alone.

announcements.headline: Nelly Group initiates share repurchase programme of up to SEK 30 million
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a return of capital to shareholders through share repurchases, which may support the share price but typically represents a routine capital management action rather than a transformative event.
